name: Bonnie Seavey
message:
Thank you Yankee Chihuahuas for all the work you do! There are far too many people "buying" Chi's and then dumping them when they are bored or frustrated.

We rescued a long haired Chi 4 years ago....she is 7 or 8 years old and we have finally convinced her that she is loved and safe.

We are hoping to adopt a brother or sister Chi to give her someone her own size to play with. Her younger sister is a 4 year old Retriever mix and doesn't like to play with her.

We were very excited by your web site and the pictures of your Chi's looking for a home. We are looking forward to possibly working with you towards an adoption.

Again, thanks for the wonderful work you do.

Bonnie Seavey
 🙂

name: Stephanie Mayo
message:
I'm the proud owner of four chis. All of them came from puppy mill-like conditions. Of the two recent "rescues", one has settled in great, the other one has deeper issues to address. I always said I would never own a Chihuahua because all the ones I ever knew were nippy little things. Now that I have them, I see how wrong I was about the breed.
            Steph

name: Shauna
message: Great page! My husband and I are interested in adopting, he has had chihuahuas before and we are taking our time to investigate all the options. I know from looking at other sites that RI pets cannot be adopted out of state. How do I find out what dogs are in RI, or is there something that can be done to deal with this? thank!
reply:
Shauna,
We take care of Chihuahuas in all six New England states, it does not matter which New England state you live in. Our foster homes are throughout the area, and volunteers co-ordinate transportation when adopting. Frequently a dog surrendered in CT will be fostered in Maine, then adopted by a family in Vermont.

name: Roger and Shirley Conant
message: In 2010 my husband and I adopted Cocoa, now called Audrey Hepburn. We have another foster Chihuahua.  Audrey was a bit unused to new sights and sounds but is gradually learning the routines here and really loving her walks, riding in the car, good food and the company of another dog.  She is a lap dog, loves to snuggle and is very playful and what beautiful and intelligent looks she gives us. And most wonderful of all she loves to sleep with her new dog friend at night.

name: Amanda Whitney
message: My partner and I adopted Fribble - now called Rocky - from YCR this week. Rocky is the best little dog - very active, loves his walks, loves to be with us. All around a great little guy. Just what I was looking for. Kate, the foser from YCR, was so good - spent a lot of time with us answering all questions and letting us get to know him. Thank you YCR for my new best friend!

name: Randall

They are both wonderful and they have helped Jasmine to move on without Camigwen.  Thank you, YCRAA, for the sunshine you brought to us.
